title: Audit log created when loyalty points accrued upon rent completion and payment
gherkin:
Feature: Reward Audit Logging
  Scenario: Loyalty points accrual audit log entry
    Given a rent transaction with status Completed and payment status Paid
    When the system assigns loyalty points to the user
    Then an audit log entry shall be created
    And the audit log shall contain a timestamp
    And the audit log shall contain a user identifier
    And the audit log shall contain event type 'loyalty_points_accrual'
    And the audit log shall contain the points amount as event outcome
    And the audit log entry shall be immutable
rationale: Core requirement from operative context: system assigns loyalty points only when rent status is Completed and payment status is Paid. Audit logs must record this event with timestamp, user identifier, event type, and outcome per operative context and supporting evidence.
usedContextItems: The system shall assign loyalty points only when rent status is Completed and payment status is Paid|Audit logs for rewards and penalties shall include timestamp, user identifier, event type, and event outcome
